chunks: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Abdillah ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from Aban ibn Uthman, from al-Fadl ibn Abd al-Malik, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
There is no breastfeeding (that causes kinship) after the two years, before weaning.
ai.seo_question: What is the time limit for breastfeeding to establish kinship in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Isfahani's chain clarifies the juristic consensus that the nursing period (radāʿ) establishing kinship (mahramiyah) is strictly limited to the first two years of life, a ruling derived from the Quranic verse on weaning. It emphasizes that nursing after this two-year mark does not create the same marital prohibitions, a key distinction in Shia fiqh for determining lineage and marriage eligibility.
